implementation.scope: One actual pharmaceutical/consumable SKU and hospital_inventory physical scope, independently reviewed original quantity unit, complete explicit future1..31 business-date drawdown scenario and finite indivisible candidate plans. Public original and current case/recipe/private-member closure are not interchangeable with latent true demand.
implementation.event_order: Per day remove expired lots, receive original dated receipts, FEFO by inclusive valid_through and stable lot ID, allocate original drawdown and evaluate shared end-of-day constraints. Frozen quantities remain unavailable; this is not an intraday availability guarantee or physical disposal.
implementation.cost: Exact original unit price times every ordered quantity, every order fixed fee and plan fixed fee, including unused/expired ordered quantity. Unknown/zero/unit/currency remain distinct; no implicit conversion/FX or full-economic-cost claim.
implementation.finite_conclusion: Only a confirmed complete candidate set with every candidate closed can prove best_among_declared_candidates (all minimum ties) or all_declared_candidates_proven_infeasible. A single unknown blocks the whole-set proof while preserving known candidate findings. No automatic candidate choice, ordering, transfers, dispensing or stock writes.
implementation.originals: Independent pharmacist self-confirmed physical total/frozen quantity and real batch/expiry observation; original current legacy capture has observed_at=NULL and cannot become a retrospective physical count. Raw catalog/batch/physical/frozen conflicts, individual negative lots and current invalid signer/unit are retained as unknown rather than filtered or canceled by a sum.
implementation.legacy_scope: Actual SKU, all real pharmaceutical batches/ledgers and unresolved purchase items; consumed/canceled purchases are outside pending obligations. Consumables have no invented batch/ledger table. Professional confirmed reconciliation binds a digest actually inspected before the atomic current capture; same catalog total with changed frozen/expiry invalidates old review.
implementation.unit: Missing original pharmaceutical unit remains None. An independent explicit one-to-one legacy-unit review/basis is required to interpret old quantities; no fabricated original unit or conversion.
implementation.governance: Current professional pharmacist signs stock observations, separate current Super-admin technically publishes originals/scenarios; whole same-SKU/scope/exact-period member closure retains unknown and invalid nonwinner candidates. Case publication requires a real zero-order/explicit-zero-plan-fee baseline.
implementation.outbound: Only typed anonymous inventory_source and complete frozen Prompt; no private raw rows, identity secret, patient/prescription/operator IDs, question, tools or unrelated hospital data. Ordinary readers check frozen Prompt/model anchors; Super additionally checks full frozen Prompt/provider, without claiming independent observation of service internals.
